title: Musify v1.7.4 Update
changelog:
- Song auto-advance fixed: next song plays automatically when one ends
- Widget controls working: Play/Pause, Next, Prev on home screen widget
- No more double-skip: debounce prevents skipping two songs at once
- Background playback: auto-advance works with screen off or app in background
- Session restore fixed: no more crash-risk on app startup
- Stream extraction: fixed potential hang in URL extraction
